GOV.UK Notify is a UK government notification service operated by the Government Digital Service (GDS) that enables central government, local authorities, NHS organisations, and other eligible public bodies to send emails, text messages, and letters to citizens on behalf of government services. The API uses JWT-based authentication and supports template-driven personalisation.
